answer: Simultaneous personhood ceremonies issue one reward credential per attendee. A market buying lagoon maps, velvet defect labels and glacier measurements checks that each claim has a valid credential and rejects a second claim with its epoch nullifier. Ceremonies run at the same time, with witnesses enforcing one physical attendee per credential, so N reward allowances require N people whom an attacker must recruit or pay. This depends on honest witnesses and resisting proxy attendance; colluding organizers can mint fake identities.
